title: TKVM's Enemies
description: Adds medieval enemies for Epic Fight! (Made for FalchionMC)
body:
### Update 4.0 (Epic Knights no longer required as a dependency.)

This mod adds 8 new enemies that have dynamic attacks, parrying, dodging. intended to be used along side Epic Fight, Indestructible, EF:Resurrection, without them, the mod will not work properly! 


### Structures
Enemies can be found in a variety of structures in the pack: 




#### Required Depdendencies

- [Huge Structure Blocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/huge-structure-blocks/versions)
- [Epic Fight](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-fight/version/20.14.11-mc1.20.1-forge)
- [Epic Fight Resurrection](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epicfight-resurrection/files/6931390)
- [Epic Fight Indestructible](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-fight-indestructible/download/6915161)
_You must go to configs -> indestructible-client.toml replace\_health\_bar = 1 -> replace\_health\_bar = 0 otherwise it will crash_


#### Recommended mods: 
[SGI-FOUNDATIONS](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/structure-generation-improver-sgi-foundations/files/7685515)

### Issues: 
Please report issues in the discord
https://discord.gg/tYMj9rTnCx

### This mod is intended for my modpack, FalchionMC (In development...)
